description: Assessment queue manager. Manages prioritization of which MCPs to assess next. GET queue of unscored servers. Priority order: (1) servers explicitly submitted via approval_workflow (highest) (2) servers discovered from npm official scope (3) servers with high scan_count but no verdict (4) servers last assessed >7d ago. Writes ordered queue to ASSESSMENT_QUEUE.md. Exposes: get_next_batch(n=10)->list of server_ids in priority order. Used by signal_analyser to pick which servers to score. No daemon, utility module.
